title: Explaining CLIP’s performance disparities on data from blind/low vision users

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot image classification accuracy of CLIP models on datasets from blind/low vision (BLV) users versus web-crawled datasets. The evaluation includes analyzing performance disparities on disability-specific objects versus non-disability objects, assessing robustness to image quality issues typical of BLV users, analyzing the frequency of disability-related terms in pre-training datasets, and testing downstream models (object detection, segmentation, and text-to-image generation) on disability content.
